observations.resulting_sequencer_behaviour: Two distinct steps. The stock display showed two lit steps and the cursor on step 3. Playback emitted note 60 twice per loop, 166 ms apart, with the loop repeating every 1500 ms, which matches nine steps of 1/8T at 120 BPM.
observations.record_time_device_output: None. The FM1 transmitted nothing while recording; every captured message is either a later playback pass or was sent by the host.

record_evidence.analysis_notes: No hardware record bytes have been captured. These fixtures observe stock behaviour only and say nothing about the internal record layout.

comparison.only_intended_difference: a second identical host note added after the first
comparison.differential_result: Two identical successive host notes occupy two separate steps; they do not collapse.

notes: SEQ-001B capture. Standard channel MIDI only: no SysEx, vendor, loader, OTA or flash traffic in either direction.
Step positions are operator-reported stock step lights; playback timings are captured MIDI.
